hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 6, 2. Both players called a raise before the cards were dealt.
Flop — 3, Jack, Queen. You bet. Your opponent raised.
Turn — King. Your opponent led out with a bet. You called.
River — 2. Your opponent fired again — half the pot.

wrongReasons: K 2 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only two pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
5 8 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only high card wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
J 10 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only one pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 10 A

Your opponent flopped a straight and immediately raised to build the pot. They led every remaining street — consistent value betting across all streets is a strong signal of a made hand.
